description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others..

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
期中/期末考學生請假補考說明

逢甲大學學則
第二十六條 學生考核請假獲准之補考規定如下：

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。
Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.

1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。
Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.

1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。

policy.course_pol:
1. Be on time. Any entry to the classroom after attendance check in the beginning of the class will be marked absence, unless you have legitimate and special reason according to the school rules. Taking too many leaves will also affect your score for course participation. If you are absent (including both excused and unexcused leaves) over 12 hours (including 12 hours), missing either midterm or final evaluation, you will fail the course. 請準時上課。點名後才進教室者該節將以曠課論，除非是因校規規定之重大事故遲到。請假過多也會影響平時成績。缺課次數(含請假及曠課)12節以上(含12節)，期中考、期末考有缺一個以上，學期總成績一律以不及格論。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration. 如需請假，學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within 14 days of the quiz date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. You are only allowed to apply for a make-up quiz at most 3 times in a semester. Only those who have taken leave on the system can apply. Missing quizzes due to late entry to the classroom or unexcused absence won't be accepted for make-up quiz. 若須要補考小考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的14天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。小考一學期至多能申請三次補考，有於系統請假者才可以申請。遲到、曠課一律不接受補考。
7. No allowance for make-up midterm exam and final presentation, unless you have got legitimate and special reason according to the school rules and: 期中考和期末考一律不接受補考和補報告，除非為特殊原因或重大事故並：
(1) Notify the course instructor before the evaluation date 於考試日期前事先告知授課教師
(2) Need approval from the course instructor in advance 經授課教師事先同意
(3) Present relevant and official evidence 提出相關正式證明文件
(4) If something emergent happened, please notify within three days of the exam/evaluation and present relevant and official documents. 如重大事件事發臨時，最晚在考試時間開始三日內告知，並提出相關正式證明文件
